BJP leader apologizes for anti-women slogans at J&K rally

A Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader has apologized following anti-women slogans chanted at a rally celebrating the abrogation of Article 370 in Jammu and Kashmir's Anantnag district. The party has distanced itself from the slogans after facing backlash. The incident occurred during a rally attended by BJP leaders and supporters.
